description: Update a workflow by id — edit the graph/trigger, or set status to 'active' (start processing live events) or 'paused'. Activation is deliberately separate from creation so a human-reviewable draft always exists first. `graph` replaces the stored graph wholesale, so read it with volanea_get_workflow first if you are amending one.

graph.description:
Automation graph. Exactly one `trigger` node is the entry point; edges connect node ids. Node types and their `config`:
- trigger: entry node, no config.
- send_email: { templateId? } and/or { subject?, body? (HTML), fromEmail?, fromName? } — template fields fill anything omitted.
- delay: { minutes?, hours?, days? } (defaults to 1 minute if all omitted).
- wait_event: { event: "<eventName>", timeoutHours? (default 72) }. The unlabeled outgoing edge fires when the event arrives; an edge labeled "timeout" is taken on timeout.
- condition: { conditions: <same condition tree as segments> }. Outgoing edges must be labeled "yes" and "no".
- update_contact: { set: { <customField>: value, ... }, subscribed? }.
- webhook: { url, payload? } — POSTs workflow/contact context to your URL (5s timeout).
- exit: ends the walk.
`x`/`y` are canvas coordinates for the dashboard editor — space nodes out (e.g. x = index * 260, y = 80).

label.description: Branch label — "yes"/"no" for condition nodes, "timeout" for wait_event.

name.description: New display name. Omit to leave it unchanged — this is a partial update, not a replace.

reentry.description: Whether a contact can enter again. `never` = once per contact, ever (welcome series). `after_exit` = again once they have finished (abandoned cart). `always` = every trigger enrols them, even mid-run — the only option that can send one contact overlapping copies, so choose it deliberately.

status.description: `draft` and `paused` workflows enrol NO ONE: matching events are silently ignored, which is the usual reason a workflow "does not fire". Set `active` to go live — that starts affecting real contacts immediately.

trigger.description: Event name that enrols a contact, e.g. `order.placed`. Must match what your app actually sends, character for character: a mismatch is not an error, it simply never fires. Check volanea_list_resources { event_names } for what this project has really recorded.

name: volanea_update_workflow

code.description: Machine-readable failure code to branch on. Present only when success is false.

status.description: Watch for a flip to active — that starts affecting real contacts immediately.

warning.description: Present when an idempotent re-create modified a live workflow.

error.description: Human-readable failure reason. Present only when success is false.

success.description: False when the call failed; read `error` and `code` in that case.
